hab: Riverbanks with a lot of boxes
Launch sites with a cowboy hat
bio: A river otter that carries everything it owns in one cardboard box. The box has a smile on it. The otter does not, until you order something.
Boxes stacked three high on its back, delivered in two days whether you asked or not. Its laugh carries across the river.
A blue rocket shell, a cowboy hat and a river current for exhaust. It went up, saw the edge, and came back with a story.
A warehouse on legs with a conveyor-belt tail and drones circling its head. It sells everything, including the shelf it stands on.
note: Started selling books. Nobody remembers that.
Its dens are the biggest buildings in every town.
Eleven minutes in orbit, ten years of telling people about it.
Charges rent to the other Billies for standing near it.
